::: {.callout-note .objectives icon="false" title="Learning Objectives Checklist"}
- [ ] **Write** `if` statements using correct syntax, indentation, and conditions.
- [ ] **Use** `if` statements to control program behaviour based on conditions.
- [ ] **Predict** the output and variable values of a program containing conditional statements.
:::



## 1. Temperature
Complete the following sample of code given the statement below and print a message when the condition is met:

   *If the temperature is below zero, display it's freezing.*

```pyodide
temperature = 3.0

# Your answer goes here
```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>What logical operator is needed to express "less than"?</p>
  </details>

:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
```pyodide
temperature = 3.0
if temperature < 0:
  print("It's freezing outside")
```
:::

## 2. Scholarship
Complete the following sample of code given the statement below and print a message when the condition is met:

   *Display "you are eligible for a scholarship" if the age of a person is between 18 and 25 (inclusive)*

```pyodide
age = 19

# Your answer goes here
```


  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>What logical operators are needed to express "less than or equal to" and "greater than or equal to"?</p>
  </details>
:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
```pyodide
age = 19

if 18 <= age <= 25:
  print("You are eligible for a scholarship")

# or, a slightly longer expression:
if (18 <= age) and (age <= 25):
  print("You are eligible for a scholarship")
```
:::

## 3. Password

Complete the following sample of code given the statement below and print a message when the condition is met:

   *Display "Successful login" if the password is "L0ngP@33w0rd34512"* 

```pyodide
password = "easypassword123"

# Your answer goes here
```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>What logical operator is needed to express "equal to"?</p>
  </details>
:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
```pyodide
password = "easypassword123"

if password == "L0ngP@33w0rd34512":
  print("Successful login")
```
:::

>  Note: This is not really how passwords are used in programs -- writing your password down as a variable in a program is a really bad idea, because everyone who can read your code can read your password! Most programs store the **hashed** version of the password -- [click this link](https://delinea.com/blog/how-do-passwords-work) if you want to learn more.

## 4. Bus Arrival
Complete the following sample of code given the statement below and print a message when the condition is met:

   *I will go to school if the bus has arrived*

```pyodide
  bus_arrived = True

  # Your answer goes here
  ```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>How can you use a boolean variable in an if statement?</p>
  </details>
:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
```pyodide
if bus_arrived:
    print("I will go to school")
```
:::

## 5. Percentage of increase
Complete the following function given the statement below and print a message when the condition is met:

  _Ensure that the percentage of increase is between -100.0 and +100.0. If it's the case calculate the increase amount_

```pyodide
stock_value = 100_000
increase_percent = 150.0
increase_amount = 0

# Your answer goes here

```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>Here you have to test a condition and calculate a percentage, but only if the condition is true.</p>
  </details>
:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
```pyodide
      increase_amount = 0
      if -100 <= increase <=100:
        increase_amount = stock_value * (increase/100)
```
:::


## 6. From code to english
Translate (to English) the meaning of the following lines of code. 

```python
r_score = 35
if r_score >= 30:
    print("You are eligible for the scholarship.")
```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>Your answer should be in the form: If (some condition is met), then (some event takes place).</p>
  </details>

:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
If the r-score is above 30, a message saying "You are eligible for a scholarship" is displayed.
:::

## 7. From code to english 2
Translate the following lines of code into human language:

```python
temperature = 12.0

if 0 <= temperature < 16:
    print("It is chilly outside.")
```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>Take care to be precise about whether something is strictly less/greater than, or less/greater than or equal to (it's different!)</p>
  </details>
:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
If the temperature is greater than or equal to 0 and if the temperature is less than 16, a message saying "It is chilly outside." is displayed.
:::

## 8. Predict the output
Write down the messages that are printed at the end of this program.

```pyodide
day=1
raining_outside = False
temperature =14.5
humidity = 0.80

day+=1
temperature -=3
humidity += 0.1

day+=1
temperature -=2
humidity += 0.1

if humidity> 0.7 and temperature <=12.0:
    raining_outside = True

day+=1
temperature -= 2
humidity/= 2

if raining_outside and humidity < 0.7:
    raining_outside = False
    temperature+=2.0
    

print(f"The temperature is {temperature}")

print(f"The humidity is {humidity}")

print(f"Is it raining outside? {raining_outside}")
```

  <details>
    <summary>👀 Hint</summary>
    <p>Make sure you start from the top and update the values of the variables as each assignment/arithmetic operator is applied, in order to get the correct answer at the end.</p>
  </details>

:::{.callout-tip title="Solution" collapse="true"}
The temperature is 9.5  
The humidity is 0.5  
Is it raining outside? False  
:::
